activity.none: No {{tool}} activity in the last 5 hours

signIn.claude: Open Claude Code to update usage
signIn.codex: Open Codex CLI to update usage
signIn.copilot: Sign in to GitHub to see usage

reduceMotion.label: Reduce motion
reduceMotion.help: Turns off decorative animation. If your system asks for less motion, that is respected either way.

alwaysOnTop.label: Always on top
alwaysOnTop.help: Keeps the widget above other windows. When it's off, clicking the tray icon brings the widget to the front.

opacity.label: Opacity
opacity.help: The widget turns fully opaque while the pointer is over it.

refresh.label: Refresh
refresh.help: How often usage is checked while the widget is showing. Hidden, it checks every 5 minutes at most.

claude.connectHelp: Reads the sign-in Claude Code keeps on this computer to show your plan limits, and its session logs when the usage API can't be reached. Only the usage request itself goes to Anthropic. Your system may ask for permission the first time.
claude.keyHelp: Optional. Adds your API spend for this month. Stored encrypted on this computer.

copilot.connectHelp: Reads the sign-in of the GitHub CLI (gh), or else of the Copilot extension in your editor, to show your Copilot quotas. Only the quota request itself goes to GitHub.
copilot.keyHelp: Optional. Used instead of those sign-ins, even when GitHub isn't connected. Stored encrypted on this computer.

unavailable.encryption: Secure storage isn't available on this system, so keys can't be saved.
unavailable.keyring: No system keyring was found (such as GNOME Keyring or KWallet), so keys can't be stored securely.

invalid.empty: Paste a key or token first.
invalid.tooLong: That's too long to be a key or token.
invalid.whitespace: Keys and tokens never contain spaces. Check what was pasted.
